jobs.description:
Director of Software Engineering

About Aumentum

Aumentum Technologies provides software solutions that support the property lifecycle for state and local governments across North America. Our products help jurisdictions manage complex processes spanning Computer-Assisted Mass Appraisal (CAMA), property assessment, valuation, tax administration, billing, collections, and related property and revenue functions.

Our software supports the work behind one of local government's most important responsibilities: accurately valuing property, administering property taxes, and managing the information and processes that connect properties, taxpayers, assessors, treasurers, and other government agencies.

Where You Fit

We are seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead and develop engineering teams responsible for multiple enterprise software products serving government customers.

This role combines people leadership, delivery ownership, and technical leadership
. You will lead engineering managers, technical leads, developers, and QA professionals while working closely with Product Management, Professional Services, and other business leaders to deliver reliable software and continuously improve how our teams operate.

You do not need to be the person writing every line of code or making every technical decision. You do need enough technical depth to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, guide teams through difficult decisions, and help translate business needs into sound engineering outcomes.

We are looking for a leader who creates accountability without creating fear, develops strong leaders beneath them, and builds teams that surface problems early and solve them together.

Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership

Lead and develop engineering managers, technical leads, developers, and QA professionals.
Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Coach managers and emerging leaders and create opportunities for engineers to grow.
Establish clear expectations while creating an environment where teams raise risks and problems early.
Recruit, retain, and develop strong engineering talent.

Delivery & Execution

Own engineering delivery across assigned product lines, including enhancements, defects, customer commitments, and technical initiatives.
Improve predictability, quality, release readiness, and engineering execution.
Work with teams to identify risks, dependencies, and obstacles before they affect customer commitments.
Support customer implementations, go-lives, production issues, and escalations when engineering leadership is needed.
Balance new product capabilities, customer needs, technical debt, and long-term platform investments.

Technical Leadership & Modernization

Provide technical direction and help teams make sound architecture and engineering decisions.
Guide modernization of mature enterprise applications while balancing innovation with customer and business needs.
Promote maintainable software, effective testing, observability, security, and sustainable engineering practices.
Ensure technical debt is understood, prioritized, and actively managed.
Stay close enough to the technology to effectively challenge, support, and guide engineering teams without becoming a bottleneck for technical decisions.

AI-Enabled Engineering

Champion practical adoption of AI throughout the software development lifecycle.
Help teams use AI as a force multiplier for development, testing, analysis, documentation, and problem solving.
Encourage experimentation while establishing appropriate expectations for quality, security, review, and accountability.
Identify opportunities to use AI to improve both engineering productivity and our products.

Cross-Functional & Customer Leadership

Partner closely with Product Management and Professional Services to establish priorities and deliver customer outcomes.
Communicate status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to business and technical leaders.
Participate in customer conversations and escalations when engineering leadership is needed.
Build trust between Engineering and the teams that depend on it.

Qualifications

Significant software engineering experience with progressive leadership responsibility.
Experience leading engineering teams and developing managers, technical leads, and senior engineers.
Strong technical foundation with the ability to understand architecture, software design, data, APIs, cloud technologies, and modern development practices.
Experience delivering and supporting complex enterprise software.
Experience balancing product development, customer commitments, technical debt, and modernization.
Demonstrated ability to improve engineering quality, execution, and predictability.
Experience leading teams through change and modernization.
Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, including testing, security, CI/CD, observability, and cloud technologies.
Practical understanding of AI-assisted software development and an interest in expanding its effective use.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively with executives, customers, Product Management, Professional Services, and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise SaaS or complex business applications.
Experience modernizing mature or legacy software platforms.
Experience with Microsoft technologies, particularly .NET, SQL Server, and Azure.
Experience with distributed systems, APIs, cloud architecture, and modern integration patterns.
Experience working with geographically distributed engineering teams.
Experience in government technology, property tax, assessment, financial systems, or another complex regulated domain.

What Success Looks Like

Engineering teams deliver high-quality software with greater predictability.
Managers and technical leaders take ownership and make effective decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Risks and problems are surfaced early rather than hidden until they become emergencies.
Product, Professional Services, and Engineering operate as partners with clear ownership and expectations.
Technical debt and modernization are addressed deliberately alongside customer and product priorities.
AI becomes a practical part of how engineering teams work and produces measurable improvements.
Engineers are growing, engaged, and accountable.
Customers and internal stakeholders view Engineering as a responsive and trusted partner.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering, Billing Platform
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Locations: Austin, London, Lisbon, SF, NYC, and Seattle

About The Role

Cloudflare's billing platform is a critical part of how customers buy, adopt, and expand across Cloudflare's products. It sits at the intersection of product monetization, customer experience, financial correctness, revenue operations, and enterprise trust.

We are hiring a Senior Director, Engineering to lead the engineering organization responsible for Cloudflare's billing platform and adjacent quote-to-cash systems. This leader will own the technical strategy, organizational design, execution model, and operational health of the systems that support usage-based billing, subscriptions, invoicing, payments, entitlements, tax, revenue data, customer account lifecycle, and financial reconciliation.

This is a senior director-level role for someone who has led managers before and can scale a multi-team platform organization where correctness, reliability, auditability, and customer trust are mandatory. The right leader will combine strong engineering judgment, manager-of-managers leadership, and executive-level partnership across Product, Finance, Revenue Operations, Legal, Sales, Support, and external platform vendors.

What You'll Do

Own the multi-year engineering strategy, investment plan, and execution roadmap for Cloudflare's billing platform and quote-to-cash integrations.
Lead and develop a distributed organization of engineering managers, senior technical leaders, and product engineering teams.
Build the next layer of leadership by coaching managers, strengthening technical leadership, and improving planning, accountability, and execution predictability.
Drive platform architecture that improves correctness, scalability, reliability, auditability, and speed of product launch.
Build systems that support usage-based billing, subscriptions, enterprise contracts, self-serve purchasing, partner and reseller motions, invoicing, payments, credits, refunds, adjustments, entitlements, tax, and customer lifecycle changes.
Strengthen financial data integrity across billing, payments, revenue recognition, ERP, CRM, data warehouse, tax, and reporting systems.
Improve reconciliation, observability, alerting, SLOs, incident response, and operational controls for billing-critical services.
Partner with Product, Finance, Revenue Operations, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Sales, and Support to turn ambiguous business requirements into durable engineering systems.
Make pragmatic build, buy, and integrate decisions across billing, payment processing, tax, ERP, CRM, entitlement, and revenue platforms.
Represent billing engineering in executive forums with clear tradeoffs, delivery status, risks, and investment recommendations.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience

15+ years of software engineering experience, including 7+ years leading engineering teams and 3+ years directly managing engineering managers.
Experience leading billing, payments, fintech, financial platforms, commerce platforms, quote-to-cash systems, or other systems where correctness and auditability are mandatory.
Strong technical judgment in distributed systems, SaaS platforms, service-oriented architectures, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud-native infrastructure.
Proven ability to define and execute a multi-year platform strategy across multiple teams, business functions, and executive stakeholders.
Experience with usage-based billing, subscription billing, metering, invoicing, payments, credits, refunds, disputes, taxation, entitlement management, revenue data, or reconciliation.
Familiarity with platforms such as Stripe or other payment processors, Salesforce or other CRM systems, ERP systems, tax engines, revenue recognition systems, data warehouses, and BI/reporting tools.
Track record improving operational excellence for critical systems through SLOs, observability, incident response, change control, migrations, reconciliation, and customer-impact reduction.
Ability to translate complex technical, financial, and organizational tradeoffs into clear decisions for executive, finance, product, and engineering audiences.
Experience recruiting, coaching, and retaining strong engineering managers and senior technical leaders.
High standards for engineering quality, accountability, documentation, customer empathy, and cross-functional follow-through.
Practical AI fluency: uses AI tools to accelerate engineering work, improve operating leverage, and raise the team's quality bar without weakening ownership or judgment.

Bonus Points

Experience modernizing or replacing legacy billing, payments, ERP, CRM, tax, entitlement, or revenue systems in a public company or high-growth SaaS business.
Experience supporting enterprise contracts, reseller or partner billing, marketplace billing, multi-currency billing, global taxation, or public-sector billing requirements.
Experience with internet-scale SaaS, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, security products, or consumption-based monetization.
Experience building platforms that support product-led growth and enterprise sales motions at the same time.
Experience leading financial-systems organizations through scale, transformation, and cross-functional operating model changes.
Experience with financial controls, SOC 2, PCI, privacy, fraud prevention, audit support, or regulated financial workflows.
Experience leading large data migrations or phased platform transformations without interrupting revenue operations or customer billing.
Strong product sense around pricing flexibility, customer transparency, billing explainability, and self-service administration.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Seattle/NYC/California based hires - Estimated annual salary of: $273,000 - $341,000
For SF/Bay Area based hires - Estimated annual salary of: $286,000 - $258,000

Equity

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

The engineering organization is a dynamic group of builders, thinkers, and problem-solvers focused on delivering scalable, AI-powered software products that improve how organizations work. We value clean architecture, intuitive experiences, operational excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement. Every engineer plays an important role in shaping the quality, reliability, and long-term success of our products.

The Service Operations Business Unit brings together IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), and CMDB capabilities on the ServiceNow Platform. This product engineering organization builds the software that helps customers deliver resilient, intelligent, and efficient enterprise services.

The Service Operations product portfolio connects incident, request, fulfillment, infrastructure visibility, service mapping, trusted configuration data, automation, and AIOps into a unified operating model. By combining service delivery with operational intelligence and trusted operational context, these products help customers move toward proactive, AI-assisted, and increasingly self-healing operations at enterprise scale.

Together, these capabilities help customers modernize how they deliver and operate services, improve reliability, reduce manual effort, and drive measurable productivity outcomes on a single platform.

What You Get To Do In This Role

As a Director of Engineering, you will lead the teams that architect and build assistive and autonomous AI-native products to usher customers (IT departments using our IT service and operations management applications) into an agentic-first era. The work will span large-scale distributed systems, data ingestion, context creation and utilization, agentic harnesses, cost optimization, and agentic feedback loops to ensure value realization for our customers.

This role requires people leadership, thought leadership, deep technical expertise, strong architectural judgment, and a keen understanding of the scientific method to ship and refine real product through iterative experimentation. You will be accountable for the growth, health, and delivery outcomes of your teams.

Responsibilities Include

Lead and grow the engineering teams responsible for assigned problem areas within ITSM/ITOM products, working with product and engineering leaders to understand blockers and opportunities around AI-native evolution and value realization.
Own technical strategy and delivery for your teams. Set architectural direction, hold the bar on quality and reliability, and stay close enough to the work to validate hypotheses through evidence, not theory.
Hire, coach, and develop engineers, tech leads, and managers. Build inclusive, high-performing teams with clear career paths and durable ownership.
Drive evidence-based decision-making: formulate hypotheses, run experiments, measure outcomes, and use data to guide architectural decisions and product direction.
Lead the evolution of current solutions toward AI-native capabilities—identifying where agentic patterns, data utilization, or autonomous workflows can unlock customer value—and translate those recommendations into staffed, executable work.
Identify and address value realization gaps in agentic products that exist but aren’t delivering expected outcomes. Diagnose root causes (architecture, UX, data quality, feedback loops, cost) and direct targeted improvements.
Establish architecture patterns, engineering standards, and operating rhythms specific to your problem domain. Document tradeoffs, rationale, and implementation guidance to help teams move faster and make consistent decisions.
Collaborate across ITSM/ITOM engineering teams to share learnings, validate approaches, and accelerate adoption of patterns that work.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Product, Design, Security, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success — aligning on roadmap and release readiness, meeting security and compliance requirements, and feeding field and customer signal back into engineering priorities.

Qualifications

15+ years of related engineering experience, including 5+ years leading and managing engineering teams (including managers or team leads), or equivalent practical experience.
Strong experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, enterprise platforms, workflow systems, data-intensive products, integration frameworks, or cloud-scale infrastructure.

Shape the AI-native future of the Service Operations Business Unit product portfolio on the ServiceNow Platform.
Build and lead the teams delivering foundational product and platform capabilities that help enterprises deliver, operate, automate, and continuously improve services at scale.
Define how AI agents, automation, operational data, and human workflows come together to create safer, more reliable, and more productive enterprise operations.

The Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) organization supports the infrastructure that enables AWS data centers to operate reliably and securely. In this role, you will work with teams responsible for maintaining and operating critical facility systems that support ongoing data center operations.

AWS operates a global portfolio of data centers. As a Chief Engineer (CE), you will contribute to the operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of facility infrastructure. This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

Key job responsibilities

Act as the primary escalation point for all facilities-related issues. Oversee operation and management of routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.

Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and responsible for working with Facility Manager (FM) to set team culture.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. Equipment will include but is not limited to stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. They manage projects from conception to completion. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

Description

Amazon is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager and interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

Also expected from the CE is the ability to manage small-to-medium impacting projects from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

The CE directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

This technical leadership position brings a 24/7 presence to support the engineering operations technicians on site and to be available to respond to site specific needs

Operate independently with limited direct management
